executionPolicy.implementation: Parallel isolated worktrees with narrow file ownership
executionPolicy.validation: One local test, build, benchmark, or native fixture generation process at a time; complete scopes before validation
executionPolicy.merge: Merge commits only; no rebase or force push

remaining: Every board item remains unproven until acceptance evidence and merged implementation are audited individually. No umbrella issue is complete merely because a foundational batch passes.
